units: Targ. Lev. IV, 3; a. fr.—ת׳ בר aurochs (v. תּוֹרְבָּלָא).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 50:10">Targ. Ps. L, 10</cite>.—

Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXVIII (ref. to וְתר̇, Gen. XV, 9) לא נאמר ת׳ זה בלשון … ת׳ זה השור וכ׳ this tor is not meant in its Biblical (Hebrew) sense (dove), but in its Chaldaic meaning: tor means the ox &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:4">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:13">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="P00167"><he>עַדְרָא</he></cite>; Bab.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:51">Lam. R. to I, 7</cite> (prov.) <he>נפל ת׳ סגין וכ׳</he> when the ox is felled, its butchers are many (when one is in distress, his enemies increase); <he>נפל ת׳ תחדדון סכינוי</he> (not <he>תחדדן</he>) when the ox is down, sharpen the knives for him; <cite ref="Shabbat 32a:2">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00176"><he>חֲדַד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16a:12">Ab. Zar. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>בר ת׳</he> a young ox; a. fr.—<he>ראש תור</he>, v. <cite ref="T00031"><he>רֹאשׁ</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="V00981"><he>תֹּרִין</he></cite>, <he>תּוֹרַיָּא</he>, <he>תּוֹרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 21:23">Targ. I Chr. XXI, 23</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 14:5">Targ. Y. Deut. XIV, 5</cite> <he>תורי בר</he>, v. supra; a. fr.—
B. Mets. 30ᵃ top; 73ᵃ; Ḥull. 84ᵇ, v. תַּיָּרָא.—Fem. תּוֹרְתָּא cow.

<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 19:2">Targ. Num. XIX, 2</cite> (O. ed. Vien. <cite ref="V00321"><he>תּוֹרְתָא</he></cite>; Y. <cite ref="V00322"><he>תּוֹרָתָא</he></cite>, corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="V00322"><he>תּוֹרָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="V00304"><he>תּוֹרָן</he></cite>.
